suggested_metrics.name: total_conversions
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN is_converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(interaction_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

suggested_metrics.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dim_billing_status.is_active_status THEN fact_subscription_monthly_snapshot.organization_hk END)

suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN is_churned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT organization_hk), 0)
